title: PIXELATION!
description: Custom kill logs and changed some icons (Absorption + Dolphin's Grace). Easy to use, even in the pure vanilla version.
body:
**Custom Kill Logs & Status Effect Icons**
This resource pack adds two simple, stylish kill log messages. When a player dies, you'll see either:

"Player has been pixelated"

"Player has been pixelated while trying to pixelate Player"

That’s it — no long, complicated death texts. Clean, funny, and perfect for casual or themed Minecraft servers.

In addition, the pack gives special new icons to status effects. Buffs like Dolphin's Grace and Absorption no longer use the default Minecraft icons. Instead, they have custom, easy-to-spot designs — making potion and effect management much faster during PvP or exploration. Other effects (Speed, Strength, Jump Boost, etc.) also receive small visual upgrades.

You might see an error message when loading the resource pack — ignore it completely. The pack works perfectly fine. All kill logs show correctly, and every custom status effect icon displays as intended. No crashes, no missing textures that matter.

**For Korean users / 한국어 사용자 참고:**
이 리소스 팩은 한국 마인크래프트에서 완벽하게 작동합니다. 오류 메시지는 무시하세요. 킬 로그("Player has been pixelated")와 특수 효과 아이콘(돌고래의 은총, 흡수 등)이 정상 출력됩니다.
